senses.en: to turn into bone
to become rigid and unable to change

ex.en: Without new ideas, a company's culture can ossify over time.
ex.zh: 如果沒有新想法，公司文化久了就會僵化。

root.note: 變成骨頭 → 骨化、僵化

senses.en: a showy display of wealth or knowledge meant to impress others

ex.en: The billionaire lives simply and avoids any ostentation.
ex.zh: 那位億萬富翁生活簡樸，避免任何炫耀。

root.note: 伸展到人面前給人看 → 炫耀

senses.en: exclusion from a society or group

ex.en: The whistleblower faced ostracism from her former colleagues.
ex.zh: 那名吹哨者遭到前同事的排擠。

root.note: 古雅典人在陶片上寫名字投票放逐 → 排斥

senses.en: to exclude someone from a group or society

ex.en: Students should never ostracize a classmate for being different.
ex.zh: 學生永遠不該因為同學與眾不同就排擠他。

root.note: 用陶片投票放逐 → 排斥

senses.en: (modal, used with 'to') used to indicate duty, correctness, or likelihood

ex.en: You ought to apologize for being so rude.
ex.zh: 你那麼沒禮貌，應該道歉。

senses.en: to force someone out of a position or place

ex.en: The shareholders voted to oust the chief executive.
ex.zh: 股東投票罷免了執行長。

senses.en: complete; absolute

ex.en: That story was an out-and-out lie.
ex.zh: 那個說法是徹頭徹尾的謊言。

senses.en: remote and seldom visited
unusual

ex.en: We found a quiet, out-of-the-way café in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們在山裡找到一間安靜、偏僻的咖啡館。

senses.en: a sudden start of war, disease, or violence

ex.en: Health officials are investigating an outbreak of food poisoning.
ex.zh: 衛生官員正在調查一起食物中毒事件的爆發。

senses.en: a sudden release of strong emotion

ex.en: The coach apologized for his angry outburst at the referee.
ex.zh: 教練為自己對裁判發飆道歉。

senses.en: a person rejected by society or a group
senses.zh: 被驅逐者；被社會遺棄的人

ex.en: After the scandal, he became an outcast in his own village.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，他在自己的村子裡成了被排斥的人。

root.note: 被丟出去的人 → 被遺棄者

senses.en: a strong public expression of anger or protest

ex.en: The plan to cut down the old trees caused a public outcry.
ex.zh: 砍伐老樹的計畫引起公眾強烈抗議。

senses.en: to do better than someone else

ex.en: The two brothers always try to outdo each other in sports.
ex.zh: 那對兄弟在運動上總想勝過對方。

senses.en: strange and unusual in a way that seems silly or shocking

ex.en: The singer is famous for her outlandish costumes.
ex.zh: 那位歌手以古怪的服裝聞名。

senses.en: to last or live longer than

ex.en: These sturdy boots will outlast any cheap pair.
ex.zh: 這雙耐穿的靴子比任何便宜貨都更持久。

senses.en: to make something illegal
a fugitive from the law; a criminal

ex.en: Several countries plan to outlaw single-use plastic bags.
ex.zh: 有幾個國家計畫禁止一次性塑膠袋。

root.note: 放到法律之外 → 宣布非法；不法之徒

senses.en: to live longer than someone
to continue after something is no longer useful

ex.en: Parrots often outlive their owners.
ex.zh: 鸚鵡常常比牠們的主人活得還久。

senses.en: a small military camp or settlement far from the main one

ex.en: The research station is a lonely outpost in Antarctica.
ex.zh: 那座研究站是南極洲一個孤零零的前哨站。

root.note: 外圍的崗位 → 前哨站

senses.en: strong anger or shock
an extremely cruel or shocking act
to make someone very angry

ex.en: The price increase caused outrage among commuters.
ex.zh: 漲價引起通勤族的憤慨。

root.note: 超出限度 → 暴行、憤慨（和 rage 其實無關）

senses.en: shockingly bad or unacceptable
senses.zh: 駭人聽聞的；無法接受的

senses.en: wildly unusual or exaggerated

ex.en: The hotel charged an outrageous price for a bottle of water.
ex.zh: 那家飯店一瓶水收的價錢貴得離譜。

senses.en: the effort to bring services or information to people who need them

ex.en: The library runs an outreach program for elderly residents.
ex.zh: 圖書館為年長居民辦理外展服務計畫。

root.note: 向外伸出援手 → 外展服務

senses.en: to ride faster or farther than
(of a ship) to survive a storm safely

ex.en: The young messenger managed to outride the soldiers chasing him.
ex.zh: 年輕的信差成功甩開追趕他的士兵。

senses.en: a float attached to the side of a canoe to keep it steady; a canoe with such a float
senses.zh: （獨木舟的）舷外浮桿；舷外浮桿獨木舟

ex.en: The islanders paddled an outrigger across the lagoon.
ex.zh: 島民划著舷外浮桿獨木舟橫渡潟湖。

senses.en: open and direct; complete
openly, completely, or immediately

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal outright.
ex.zh: 委員會斷然否決了這項提案。

senses.en: the outer edge of a town or city (usually plural: outskirts)
senses.zh: 郊區；市郊（多用複數 outskirts）

ex.en: The new stadium was built on the western outskirt of the city.
ex.zh: 新體育場建在城市西郊。

senses.en: to extend or stretch out

ex.en: The toddler would outstretch her arms whenever she wanted to be picked up.
ex.zh: 那個小娃兒每次想被抱，就會伸出雙臂。

senses.en: to exceed or move faster than

ex.en: Demand for the new game console may outstrip supply.
ex.zh: 新遊戲主機的需求可能會超過供應。

senses.en: to be greater in weight, value, or importance than

ex.en: The benefits of exercise far outweigh the risks.
ex.zh: 運動的好處遠大於風險。

senses.en: to do something too much; to exaggerate

ex.en: Don't overdo it at the gym on your first day.
ex.zh: 第一天上健身房別練得太過頭。

senses.en: too large a dose of a drug
to take too much of a drug

ex.en: An overdose of this painkiller can damage the liver.
ex.zh: 這種止痛藥過量會傷害肝臟。

senses.en: to eat too much

ex.en: It's easy to overeat at a buffet.
ex.zh: 在吃到飽餐廳很容易吃太多。

senses.en: to stick out over something below
[ˋovɚˏhæŋ] a part that sticks out over something

ex.en: The branches overhang the path and drip water after rain.
ex.zh: 樹枝懸垂在小徑上方，雨後還會滴水。

senses.en: to leap over; to overlook or omit

ex.en: The deer tried to overleap the fence but got caught in the wire.
ex.zh: 那隻鹿想跳過圍籬，卻被鐵絲纏住。

senses.en: a ruler with power over other rulers or lords

ex.en: The local chiefs paid taxes to their foreign overlord.
ex.zh: 地方首領向他們的外國霸主繳稅。

root.note: 在領主之上的人 → 霸主

senses.en: a bridge that carries one road over another

ex.en: Pedestrians use the overpass to cross the busy highway.
ex.zh: 行人利用天橋穿越繁忙的公路。

root.note: 從上面越過的通道 → 天橋

senses.en: to pay too much for something

ex.en: Compare prices online so you don't overpay for a used car.
ex.zh: 上網比價，買二手車才不會當冤大頭。

senses.en: to defeat with greater strength
to be too intense for; to overwhelm

ex.en: The guards managed to overpower the thief before he escaped.
ex.zh: 警衛在小偷逃走前成功將他制伏。

senses.en: production of more goods than are needed or can be sold

ex.en: Overproduction of rice caused prices to fall sharply.
ex.zh: 稻米生產過剩導致價格大跌。

senses.en: to try to do more than one is able to or has authority to
senses.zh: 做得過頭；逾越權限；不自量力

ex.en: The court warned that the agency must not overreach its authority.
ex.zh: 法院警告該機關不得逾越其權限。

senses.en: to spread over or occupy a place in large numbers
to go beyond a limit of time or cost

ex.en: If we do nothing, weeds will overrun the garden.
ex.zh: 如果我們什麼都不做，雜草就會長滿整個花園。

root.note: 跑遍、越過 → 蔓延、超出

senses.en: to supervise a person or work

ex.en: She was hired to oversee the construction of the new library.
ex.zh: 她受聘監督新圖書館的興建工程。

senses.en: a person who supervises others, especially workers

ex.en: The overseer checked the workers' progress every morning.
ex.zh: 監工每天早上檢查工人的進度。

root.note: 在上面看著的人 → 監工

senses.en: to make someone or something seem less important
to cast a shadow over; to make gloomy

ex.en: The scandal will overshadow everything else the mayor has done.
ex.zh: 這樁醜聞將蓋過市長做過的其他一切。

root.note: 在上面投下陰影 → 使相形見絀

senses.en: to stride over or beyond; to straddle

ex.en: The giant could overstride the river in a single step.
ex.zh: 那個巨人一步就能跨過那條河。

senses.en: to remove a leader or government from power by force
[ˋovɚˏθro] the removal of a government by force

ex.en: The rebels planned to overthrow the king.
ex.zh: 叛軍計畫推翻國王。

senses.en: a subtle or implied quality, meaning, or feeling
(music) a higher tone heard along with the main note

ex.en: Her polite reply had an overtone of irritation.
ex.zh: 她禮貌的回應裡帶著一絲不耐煩。

root.note: 主音之上的聲音 → 泛音、弦外之音

senses.en: an approach or proposal made to start talks or a relationship
an orchestral piece at the start of an opera or musical work

ex.en: The company rejected every overture from its rival to discuss a merger.
ex.zh: 那家公司拒絕了競爭對手每一次商討合併的提議。

root.note: 打開（局面）→ 序曲、主動示好

senses.en: weighing more than is normal or healthy

ex.en: The airline charged extra because my suitcase was overweight.
ex.zh: 因為我的行李超重，航空公司多收了費用。

senses.en: to calm someone who is angry or upset
to bring peace to an area, often by force

ex.en: The manager offered a refund to pacify the angry customer.
ex.zh: 經理提出退款以安撫那位生氣的顧客。

senses.en: a small package or envelope
a unit of data sent over a network

ex.en: Add one packet of sugar to your coffee.
ex.zh: 在咖啡裡加一包糖。

senses.en: a formal agreement between people or countries

ex.en: The two friends made a pact to study together every weekend.
ex.zh: 兩個朋友約定每個週末一起讀書。

senses.en: a person holding religious beliefs other than the main world religions, especially in ancient times
relating to such beliefs

ex.en: Many modern holidays began as pagan festivals celebrating the seasons.
ex.zh: 許多現代節日起源於慶祝季節的異教節慶。

parts.m: village, countryside 鄉村（拉丁文 pagus）

root.note: 鄉下人（較晚接受基督教）→ 異教徒

senses.en: a public show or parade, often in costume, depicting historical scenes
a beauty contest

ex.en: The town held a colorful pageant to celebrate its 300th anniversary.
ex.zh: 小鎮舉辦了一場多采多姿的遊行，慶祝建鎮三百週年。

senses.en: the roof of the mouth
a person's sense of taste

ex.en: This spicy dish may be too strong for a child's palate.
ex.zh: 這道辣菜對小孩的口味來說可能太重了。

mn: palate（上顎、味覺）、palette（調色盤）、pallet（貨板）發音相同，拼法不同。

senses.en: resembling a palace; large and luxurious

ex.en: The movie star lives in a palatial mansion by the sea.
ex.zh: 那位電影明星住在海邊一棟宮殿般的豪宅裡。

senses.en: the study of fossils and ancient life

ex.en: His love of dinosaurs led him to study paleontology.
ex.zh: 他對恐龍的熱愛讓他攻讀古生物學。

senses.en: a thin board on which an artist mixes paints
the range of colors used by an artist or in a design

ex.en: The designer chose a calm palette of blues and greens for the room.
ex.zh: 設計師為房間選了一組沉靜的藍綠色調。

senses.en: a poem in which the poet takes back something said in an earlier poem; a formal retraction
senses.zh: （詩人所寫的）翻案詩；正式撤回前言

ex.en: After the criticism, the poet wrote a palinode taking back his harsh words.
ex.zh: 受到批評後，那位詩人寫了一首翻案詩，收回他嚴厲的言詞。

root.note: 唱反調的歌 → 翻案詩

senses.en: a dark cloud of smoke or dust; a gloomy atmosphere
a cloth spread over a coffin
to become less interesting or appealing

ex.en: The news of the accident cast a pall over the celebration.
ex.zh: 意外的消息讓慶祝活動蒙上一層陰影。

mn: cast a pall over：給……蒙上陰影。

senses.en: to make a disease or its symptoms less severe without curing it
to make an offense seem less serious

ex.en: The medicine can palliate the pain but cannot cure the illness.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以減輕疼痛，卻無法治癒疾病。

root.note: 用斗篷蓋住 → 掩飾、緩和

senses.en: pale, especially because of poor health
lacking energy or interest; dull

ex.en: After weeks in the hospital, his face looked pallid and thin.
ex.zh: 住院幾週後，他的臉看起來蒼白消瘦。

senses.en: so intense or obvious that it can almost be touched
able to be felt by touch

ex.en: The tension in the room was palpable as they waited for the results.
ex.zh: 等待結果時，房間裡的緊張氣氛幾乎可以摸得到。

root.note: 可以摸得到的 → 明顯的

senses.en: paralysis, often with uncontrollable shaking

ex.en: Cerebral palsy affects movement and muscle control.
ex.zh: 腦性麻痺會影響動作與肌肉控制。

mn: palsy 是 paralysis 在古法文中的縮略變形。

senses.en: (heraldry) divided into vertical stripes of alternating colors
(archaic) pale

ex.en: The knight's shield was paly of red and gold.
ex.zh: 騎士的盾牌是紅金相間的縱條紋。

parts.m: stake, vertical stripe 木樁、縱條

root.note: 像一排木樁的 → 縱條紋的

senses.en: a small booklet with information or arguments on a single subject

ex.en: The nurse gave me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 護理師給了我一本關於健康飲食的小冊子。

senses.en: a writer of pamphlets, especially political ones
senses.zh: 小冊子作者（尤指政治性的）

ex.en: Thomas Paine was a famous pamphleteer during the American Revolution.
ex.zh: 湯瑪斯．潘恩是美國獨立戰爭期間著名的政論小冊作家。

senses.en: relating to all the countries of North, Central, and South America

ex.en: She won a gold medal at the Pan-American Games.
ex.zh: 她在泛美運動會上贏得金牌。

senses.en: a solution or remedy for all problems or diseases

ex.en: Technology is not a panacea for every problem in education.
ex.zh: 科技不是解決所有教育問題的萬靈丹。

senses.en: an outbreak of a disease over a whole country or the world
(of a disease) spread over a very wide area

ex.en: The pandemic forced schools around the world to move classes online.
ex.zh: 疫情大流行迫使全世界的學校改為線上上課。

root.note: 影響所有人的 → 大流行的

mn: epidemic 是地區性流行，pandemic 是跨國、全球性大流行。

senses.en: wild and noisy disorder or confusion

ex.en: Pandemonium broke out when the fire alarm went off during the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會中火警鈴大作，現場一片大亂。

root.note: 所有惡魔聚集之處（彌爾頓《失樂園》）→ 大混亂

senses.en: a public speech or text in praise of someone

ex.en: The retiring professor's colleagues delivered a warm panegyric.
ex.zh: 同事們為即將退休的教授發表了一篇溫暖的頌詞。

root.note: 在全民集會上的演說 → 頌詞

senses.en: a flat piece forming part of a surface, such as a door or wall
a small group of people chosen to discuss or judge something

ex.en: A panel of experts will judge the science fair.
ex.zh: 一組專家將擔任科展的評審。

senses.en: sudden, uncontrollable fear
to feel sudden fear and act without thinking

ex.en: Don't panic if you forget a line; just keep going.
ex.zh: 忘詞時別慌，繼續下去就好。

root.note: 希臘牧神潘會在山林中製造令人恐慌的聲響 → 恐慌

senses.en: a complete or impressive collection of things
senses.zh: 一系列；全套；壯觀的陣容

senses.en: a complete suit of armor

ex.en: The kitchen has a whole panoply of gadgets for making desserts.
ex.zh: 這間廚房有全套做甜點的器具。

parts.m: arms, weapons 武器（希臘文 hopla）

senses.en: a wide, unbroken view of an area
a complete survey of a subject

ex.en: From the tower, we enjoyed a panorama of the entire city.
ex.zh: 從塔上，我們欣賞到整座城市的全景。

root.note: 看到全部的景色 → 全景

senses.en: the belief that God and the universe are identical

ex.en: The poet's love of nature bordered on pantheism.
ex.zh: 那位詩人對自然的熱愛近乎泛神論。

senses.en: a temple in Rome dedicated to all the gods
(lowercase) all the gods of a people; a group of highly respected people

ex.en: The Pantheon in Rome has a huge dome with an open hole at the top.
ex.zh: 羅馬萬神殿有一座頂端開著圓洞的巨大圓頂。

root.note: 所有神的神殿 → 萬神殿

senses.en: the use of gestures and movements without words to tell a story
(British) a comic musical play for families at Christmas

ex.en: The actor used pantomime to show he was trapped inside a glass box.
ex.zh: 那位演員以默劇動作表現自己被困在玻璃箱裡。

root.note: 模仿一切的表演 → 默劇

senses.en: a wide-angle camera or lens that photographs a very broad view
senses.zh: 廣角（全景）相機；廣角鏡頭

ex.en: The early photographer used a pantoscope to capture the whole harbor.
ex.zh: 那位早期攝影師用廣角相機拍下整個港口。

root.note: 看到全部 → 全景相機

senses.en: the office or authority of the pope; a pope's term
senses.zh: 教宗職位；教宗任期；教宗權力

ex.en: During his papacy, the pope visited more than fifty countries.
ex.zh: 這位教宗在任期間造訪了五十多個國家。

senses.en: a material like paper made from a water plant in ancient Egypt; a document written on it

ex.en: Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus made from reeds along the Nile.
ex.zh: 古埃及人在用尼羅河畔蘆葦做的莎草紙上書寫。

mn: paper 這個字就是從 papyrus 來的。

senses.en: a simple story used to teach a moral or spiritual lesson

ex.en: The teacher told a parable about a lost sheep to explain forgiveness.
ex.zh: 老師講了一則迷途羔羊的寓言來說明寬恕。

root.note: 把兩件事放在一起比較 → 比喻、寓言

senses.en: a statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true
senses.zh: 悖論；似非而是的說法；矛盾的事

ex.en: It is a paradox that the more choices we have, the less satisfied we feel.
ex.zh: 選擇越多反而越不滿足，這真是個矛盾。

root.note: 違反一般看法 → 悖論

senses.en: a perfect example of a quality

ex.en: My grandmother was a paragon of patience and kindness.
ex.zh: 我祖母是耐心與仁慈的典範。

senses.en: side by side and the same distance apart
similar or happening at the same time
a similarity or comparison

ex.en: The historian drew a parallel between the two economic crises.
ex.zh: 那位歷史學家將兩次經濟危機拿來類比。

parts.m: one another 彼此（希臘文 allelon）

senses.en: the state of being parallel or similar
the use of similar grammatical structures in a sentence for effect

ex.en: The speech used parallelism to make its message memorable.
ex.zh: 那篇演講使用排比句，讓訊息令人難忘。

mn: SAT 文法常考 parallelism：並列的成分要用相同詞性與結構。

senses.en: the loss of the ability to move part of the body
a state of being unable to act or function

ex.en: Political paralysis prevented the government from passing a budget.
ex.zh: 政治僵局讓政府無法通過預算。

senses.en: to make a person or body part unable to move
to bring to a stop; to make unable to function

ex.en: A major snowstorm could paralyze the city's transportation system.
ex.zh: 一場大雪可能使城市交通癱瘓。

root.note: 使鬆軟無力 → 使癱瘓

senses.en: more important than anything else; supreme

ex.en: Passenger safety is paramount for every airline.
ex.zh: 對每家航空公司來說，乘客安全都是最重要的。

root.note: 在最高處 → 最重要的

senses.en: a lover, especially a secret one of a married person

ex.en: In the opera, the queen secretly meets her paramour in the garden.
ex.zh: 在那齣歌劇裡，皇后在花園與她的情人祕密幽會。

senses.en: the equipment or objects needed for an activity

ex.en: His car was full of camping paraphernalia.
ex.zh: 他的車裡塞滿了露營用品。

root.note: 嫁妝以外的私人物品 → 零星用品

senses.en: to express the meaning of something using different words
a restatement of a text in other words

ex.en: Try to paraphrase the article instead of copying it.
ex.zh: 試著改寫那篇文章，不要照抄。

root.note: 在旁邊用另一種說法 → 改寫

senses.en: to trim by cutting away the outer edge or skin
to reduce something gradually

ex.en: We need to pare the budget to save money.
ex.zh: 我們需要削減預算來省錢。

senses.en: the identity or origin of a person's parents

ex.en: The orphan knew nothing about his parentage.
ex.zh: 那個孤兒對自己的身世一無所知。

senses.en: an outcast; a person rejected by society

ex.en: After the scandal, the senator became a political pariah.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，那名參議員成了政壇上人人避之的對象。

mn: 原指印度南部的低種姓族群，現多小寫表示「被排斥者」。

senses.en: a church district with its own church and priest
a small unit of local government
senses.zh: （英國）行政教區；（美國路易斯安那州的）郡

ex.en: The priest knew almost everyone in his parish.
ex.zh: 那位神父幾乎認識他教區裡的每一個人。

senses.en: relating to Paris
a person from Paris

ex.en: The café had a charming Parisian atmosphere.
ex.zh: 那家咖啡館有迷人的巴黎風情。

senses.en: the state of being equal, especially in pay or status

ex.en: Women's teams are demanding pay parity with men's teams.
ex.zh: 女子隊伍要求與男子隊伍同酬。

senses.en: a particular way of speaking or using words

ex.en: In computer parlance, a "bug" is an error in a program.
ex.zh: 在電腦用語中，「bug」是指程式裡的錯誤。

senses.en: a discussion between enemies to settle a dispute
to hold such a discussion

ex.en: The two commanders agreed to parley under a flag of truce.
ex.zh: 兩名指揮官同意在停戰旗下進行和談。
